Ivy League Tournament champions |bowl= [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = First Round }} {{2018–19 Ivy League men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 Yale Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Yale University]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Bulldogs, led by 20th-year head coach [[James Jones (basketball, born 1964)|James Jones]], played their home games at John J. Lee Amphitheater of the [[Payne Whitney Gymnasium]] in [[New Haven, Connecticut]] as members of the [[Ivy League]]. They finished the season 22–8 to finish a tie for 1st place. In the Ivy Tournament, they beat [[2018–19 Princeton Tigers men's basketball team|Princeton]] in the semifinals and beating [[2018–19 Harvard Crimson men's basketball team|Harvard]] in the Ivy Championship to win the Ivy League title. They received an automatic bid to the NCAA Tournament getting a 14th seed before losing to [[2018–19 LSU Tigers basketball team|LSU]] in the first round. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 Yale Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 16–15, 9–5 in Ivy League play to finish in third place.
